answer: A practical defense anchors each agent identity to a refundable deposit locked in a shared vault before it can earn. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents get theirs back. Like a mesa, the cost stays flat and predictable for legitimate users but rises steeply in total for an attacker who must fund every copy. If an agent misbehaves, part of its deposit is slashed, so sybil farming becomes a losing trade.
